scope: Extend the completed three-symbol offline Kraken Spot pilot to every exact mapped symbol whose requested first-UTC-day data was officially available. This is raw research-data acquisition only; no model, policy, admission, feature, live inference, or execution code changed.

mapping_contract.rule: exact BASE/USD:USD perpetual to BASE/USD Kraken Spot membership only; no aliases, quote substitutions, or fuzzy mappings

bounded_sample.free_sample_rule: first UTC day of month only

integrity_and_resume.transport: bounded direct official Tardis dataset URL
integrity_and_resume.verification: Every new gzip was fully read for CRC/trailer validation and SHA-256 before atomic promotion. Existing verified files were revalidated rather than overwritten.
integrity_and_resume.raw_immutability: No raw input was removed or overwritten. Each manifest row persists the promoted path, byte size, and SHA-256 checksum.
